preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `clean_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Replace the placeholder room with exactly one intact authored daylight FPS environment, grounded through one product-owned wrapper at credible human scale, and prove a safe 30–45 second collision-backed spawn-to-Alpha traversal. Rebind Alpha on the authored walkable surface with authoritative enter/leave telemetry while preserving the verified player controller and clean boot.

diagnosis.root_cause: The candidate remains the verified locomotion blockout: its bounded primitive room is still the visible world, so the selected arena-foundation increment has no complete authored environment, shared map datum, fixed street-level spawn, or measured collision-backed spawn-to-Alpha route. Independently, the existing Alpha Area3D remains presentation and collision geometry without an authoritative signal-bound state owner or event trace. The environment gap is an expected missing product increment rather than a prior failed verdict; the Alpha defect is confirmed issue debt that can share the same route integration pass.

stop_conditions: Do not acquire or bind weapons, hands, HUD, minimap, enemies, decorative scatter, B/C mission systems, or final UI during this iteration.

Reject any environment candidate that cannot remain an intact single instance because of missing dependencies, unusable materials, incompatible scale, or absent playable topology; do not merge multiple maps or repair it through source surgery.
Do not move, hide, extract, duplicate, rescale, or replace individual authored child meshes, streets, buildings, props, or materials; all calibration belongs on one product-owned outer wrapper.
Do not shorten the route or move Alpha near spawn merely to satisfy collision testing; the ordinary-input effective route must remain within the PRD's 30–45 second budget.
Do not hand off while clean boot, verified locomotion behavior, ground contact, material loading, or Alpha transition authority is regressed.
Leave the unselected arena-foundation review and environment-integrity backlog gaps to later host-owned iterations.

strategy.rationale: Advance the selected phase through one coherent major-family intake: audition and bind one complete authored environment as a justified singleton, calibrate only its outer wrapper, and use its native topology for spawn, route, cover, collision, and Alpha placement. Repair the carried Alpha authority defect at the new anchor rather than preserving the obsolete blockout placement.

code: Verify the selected package's license/attribution, external dependencies, imported entry scene, mesh/material/texture bindings, and full bounds before accepting it.

Verify main.tscn reaches one intact environment instance through one outer wrapper and contains no retained placeholder floor, partial-map extraction, duplicated map instance, or per-child compensation.
Verify spawn, collision, navigation support, route probe, Alpha Area3D, signal bindings, bounded event history, and player identity filtering are discoverable candidate-owned structures.
Run focused parse/import/boot checks and require the frozen clean_boot validation to pass without errors.
runtime: GameLoop Runtime/Tester launches from fresh F6 state and records map bounds, wrapper transform, fixed spawn transform, grounded player state, nearby surface, collision, and clean logs before movement.

Using ordinary input only, measure spawn-to-Alpha effective traversal at 30–45 seconds and bind timestamped positions, grounded state, route decisions, collisions, and final objective distance; teleports or scripted playback do not count.

From outside Alpha, enter and fully leave it through ordinary movement and require ordered enter/leave events, overlap state, objective state, transition count, and player position to agree without duplicates.

Probe representative map boundaries, route cover, elevation changes, and navigation/collision alignment; require no roof/void spawn, fall-through, escape, floating anchor, missing surface, or proxy-floor substitution.
visual: Capture separated runtime views at spawn, a critical route decision, a native landmark/Alpha approach, inside Alpha, and a ground-contact close-up; pair each frame with its state and viewpoint identity.

Inspect the highest-exposure environment surfaces in the imported and running scene for intact geometry, meaningful native composition, loaded materials/textures, neutral daylight, readable shadows, and absence of matte or edge-color contamination.

Show the player-scale camera beside representative doors, cover, stairs, vehicles or props and reject miniature/oversized architecture, buried camera, floating ground contact, or incoherent cover height.
Confirm Alpha remains readable without its volume, marker, or Label3D crossing the near plane, obscuring the central view, or becoming a full-height visual curtain.

done_when: Exactly one licensed complete authored FPS environment is materialized, instantiated once from the running main scene, and supplies the sole visible map with its native geometry, streets, structures, props, materials, textures, and landmarks intact.

One product-owned outer wrapper establishes the map scale and ground datum; measured bounds and player comparisons show credible proportions at doors, cover, stairs, and landmarks without per-child transforms or visible calibration geometry.

A fixed safe spawn begins on native walkable ground, and ordinary input reaches Alpha in 30–45 effective seconds through collision-backed native topology without roof/void spawn, fall-through, collision escape, proxy floors, teleports, or route-shortening.

The spawn-to-Alpha segment uses meaningful native cover and recognizable route decisions, while Alpha sits on an authored perimeter surface, is not directly exposed from spawn, and remains readable on approach.

Alpha owns stable identity, outside/inside state, occupant state, deduplicated signal bindings, transition count, last event, and bounded ordered enter/leave history discoverable with player locomotion telemetry.
A fresh outside→inside→outside traversal records exactly one enter and one leave transition whose player position, overlap predicate, prior/resulting state, and event sequence agree.

The verified CharacterBody3D hierarchy, capsule, camera, locomotion modes, crouch behavior, F6 restart, input capture, and clean R behavior remain intact, with no later-phase component family introduced.
The exact candidate boots without missing resources, material failures, script errors, signal errors, invalid collision, or navigation-related runtime errors.
tasks.instructions: Developer must perform bounded asset/reference discovery, preview candidates, and select one licensed complete authored FPS environment matching a grounded realistic daylight military base; no initial package is prescribed. Materialize its coherent registered scope, keep raw imported sources immutable, and instantiate the complete scene exactly once beneath a product-owned arena wrapper. Remove the obsolete placeholder room and calibrate map scale/datum only at that wrapper. Add only collision/navigation support, playable boundaries, safe spawn, route instrumentation, and a Point A anchor required by this phase, using native streets and cover rather than planes, patches, barriers, or scatter. Preserve the existing player controller and rebase its spawn to authored ground. Add a minimal authoritative Alpha owner, bind body enter/exit with explicit player filtering and duplicate suppression, and expose bounded ordered transition telemetry. Asset plan: family_id=arena_foundation.authored_environment; prd_style_match=grounded realistic daylight military-base FPS; source_quality_class=complete authored environment justified singleton; material_and_texture_evidence=inspect the actual Godot-imported scene, dependencies, meshes, materials, textures, bounds, scale, and runtime bindings; expected_runtime_uses_or_visible_area_share=one intact instance supplying approximately 100% of visible world fill; minimum_distinct_source_variants=1; minimum_runtime_variants=1; maximum_single_variant_share=1.0; diversity_axes=native authored submeshes and landmarks are internal composition, not separate variant families; background_mode=opaque full-scene environment with neutral daylight; runtime_evidence_views=imported overview, spawn, critical route choices, Alpha approach/volume, and ground-contact close-up.
tasks.title: Ground one intact authored arena and rebind Alpha authority
